name: Akizuki Yuuta
source:
He graduated from university and started working at his current company.

He was a serious person with mundane hobbies like watching movies and nothing to be proud of.

In the past, when he dated women, he was dumped because they said he was boring.

As he talked to Moeka, who was his subordinate, he became friends with her and developed feelings for her, so they started dating.
